# Onboarding guide

Welcome to the team. This page lists what to do in your first week.

## Day one

* [ ] Collect your laptop
* [ ] Set up email and chat
* [ ] Meet your onboarding buddy

## Week one

* Read the architecture overview.
* Shadow a support shift.
* Ship a small change to production.
